description: Read a Google Business location profile or look up Google Business categories. view=profile (default): read title, description, primary and additional categories, services, phone numbers, website URL, regular opening hours, attributes, and pending-review status for one location (pass account_id or location_id). view=categories: search Google Business categories via categories.list (region_code and language_code required, optional prefix filter, category_view BASIC or FULL, page_size up to 100, page_token). Stays off until location edits are switched on, and does not call Google while it is off.

account_id.description: Google Business account ID from list_accounts.

category_view.description: categories: BASIC (default) or FULL (includes service types and more-hours types).

include_google_updated.description: profile: when true, also check Google-suggested updates (the getGoogleUpdated method).

language_code.description: categories: BCP-47 language code, e.g. en or en-GB.

location_id.description: Google Business numeric location id (the location_id/platform_user_id from list_accounts, e.g. "197940849675145390"). NOT the ChIJ... Place ID from list_google_business_reviews view=review_link. Prefer account_id.

page_size.description: categories: max results per page (1 to 100, default 50).

page_token.description: categories: next_page_token from a previous categories response.

prefix.description: categories: optional category display name prefix filter.

region_code.description: categories: two-letter ISO country code, e.g. US or GB.

workspace_id.description: Filter to a workspace ID from whoami.

name: list_google_business_locations
